name: JVC Android TV (Vestel)
summary: JVC Android TV ships with Vestel telemetry and preloaded apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This JVC Android TV, built by Vestel for Spain, ships with Vestel telemetry and a cleaner app. It also has Google and partner attribution, feedback and auto-installs, preloaded apps and background services nobody needs on a TV. The list has 25 apps. It uses the classic Android TV home.

It was disabled in two batches on one TV. Prime Video and Disney+ were kept at the owner's choice. The Input key, Live TV, Chromecast built-in and Gboard keep working. TidyTV turns the rest off from your phone with a backup first and deletes nothing. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Input key handler, which looks like retail demo mode
Live TV and the TV service
Chromecast built-in, Play Store and Play Services
The Vestel TV, key, backlight and remote update services
notes: One MediaTek home screen helper crashes the TV service if it is turned off, so it stays on.
There is no separate firmware update app on this TV. Updates live in Settings.

faq.q: Will the Input button still work on my JVC TV?
faq.a: Yes. The app that handles it looks like bloat, but it must stay on, so TidyTV keeps it.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
